name: Cart Donation for WooCommerce
author: Christian Rassin

sections.description:
Perfect for adding tips, charity donations or optional contributions directly in the WooCommerce cart.

Cart Donation for WooCommerce allows customers to easily add a donation directly from the cart page.

The plugin automatically creates a hidden donation product and adds it to the cart using a smooth AJAX experience.

This plugin does not collect or store personal data on its own.

Requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Perfect for:

  • Charity donations
  • Tips
  • Support contributions
  • Rounding up orders

Features

  • Custom donation amounts
  • Quick-select donation buttons
  • AJAX add-to-cart (no page reload required)
  • Only one donation item in cart (automatically replaced)
  • Fully removable donation item
  • Multi-language support (EN, NL, FR, DE, ES, IT)
  • Customizable donation box title
  • Custom donation product image
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Compatible with most properly coded WooCommerce themes

Usage

  • Customers can enter a custom amount or use quick-select buttons.
  • Only one donation is active in the cart at a time.
  • Adding a new donation replaces the previous one.
  • Donations are added via AJAX for a smooth experience.

Note:
The donation option in the cart is only displayed when another product has been added. You can then remove that product, leaving only the donation in the cart.

Pro version: Create and place multiple donation blocks in the cart or anywhere on your website using flexible placement options, shortcode support, and many more advanced features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress or install via the Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Cart Donation in the admin menu
  4. Configure your settings

On activation, the plugin automatically creates a hidden virtual WooCommerce product named “Donation (Auto)”.
sections.faq:
Can I change the donation product image?

Yes, via the plugin settings page.

Can I change the quick donation amounts?

Yes, you can configure the quick-select buttons in the settings.

Can I change the donation title?

Yes, you can customize the donation box title in the settings.

Does it support AJAX?

Yes, donations are added via AJAX with a fallback mechanism.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all properly coded WooCommerce themes.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes, you can configure most style settings in the Cart Donation admin page under the “Style” tab.
